1986-12-02: Behind Kelvin Scarborough's 26 points, New Mexico Lobos pulled away from Jackson State Tigers 75–62. Jeffery Hart had 26 for Jackson State Tigers. Jeffery Hart grabbed 17 rebounds.
1998-11-13: Missouri Tigers blew out Jackson State Tigers 87–46 as Albert White scored a team-high 22.
